text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 3

An all-male panel selecting a man over another man says essentially nothing about sex discrimination against you. If anything, the composition would raise questions for a woman who was passed over — not for you. Raising it would weaken your position by signalling you're reaching for a grievance rather than examining the actual decision.

Your real argument is substantive: a PhD in clinical biochemistry and eight years running a section against a master's and a management course. "Broad leadership experience" is vague and worth probing.

Focus on the unanswered request. Send a written follow-up, citing the date of your original request, and ask for the panel's scoring criteria and how each candidate was assessed against them.
